representation_symmetry.theorem: (c,f) is exact-channel representable iff (f,c) is exact-channel representable.
representation_symmetry.unique_hub: The unique hub is the same vertex z because N(c) intersect N(f) is symmetric.

implication_duality.consequence: Reach in the reversed-anchor implication graph equals predecessor reachability in the original graph.

lattice_duality.order_relation: Complement is an order-reversing bijection, so the two representation lattices are dual distributive lattices.
lattice_duality.SCC_poset: The flexible SCC condensation for reversed anchors is the order-dual DAG of the original flexible SCC condensation.

capacity_symmetry.reason: Undirected local vertex connectivity is symmetric, lambda_G(c,f)=lambda_G(f,c).

unordered_anchor_normal_form.statement: Pure exact-channel representability is naturally a property of the unordered anchor pair {c,f}.
canonical_pipeline: Compute the unique common neighbor z if it exists.
Choose one orientation only for the purpose of naming L/R and constructing the implication lattice.
The opposite orientation carries no new representability or capacity information; it is the dual lattice.
